summary: Implemented the Tabs feature without running any repository code or tests, as instructed. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs); UnderlineBar now takes clickable_ranges before width and yields one Text with click spans last; Opacity merges the blended color into existing styles so click metadata is kept; new tests in tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py (appended, existing tests untouched) and tests/widgets/test_tabs.py (plus tests/widgets/__init__.py); docs/reference/tabs.md. The layout resolver was left unchanged because its Edge protocol already declares size, min_size (default 1), and fraction (default 1). The sandbox demo was skipped as optional. Nothing was committed. Unverified: that rich preserves @click metadata through Text base-style rendering and Style addition, that Segment.line() exists in the installed rich, and the whole test suite. An empty label gets a flexible one-cell edge.
